verdict.rationale: The product documents a public test relay and a default local demo that starts its own relay and publishes a test video, so users can experiment away from a production deployment. Neither is documented as an isolated sandbox: the anon relay is public and shared, and nothing explains how test data stays separate from production. Missing for 10: documented sandbox isolation guarantees, separation of test from production credentials and data, agent-oriented sandbox workflow docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A public test relay runs at `https://cdn.moq.dev/anon`.
The default demo starts a relay, publishes a test video, and opens the web player.
